scope: Construction and process installation of one explicitly selected two-train municipal MBR wastewater treatment plant WWTP-MBR-1000-2T for 1000 m3/day design flow and 1500 m3/day peak flow. The selected SCREEN_GRIT_ANOXIC_AEROBIC_MBR_UV train, influent and effluent criteria, eight MBR-CASSETTE-50M3H membrane cassettes and all direct process, civil, commissioning, labor, mechanism, QA and logistics inputs are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater process and civil designer, MBR system supplier, equipment manufacturers, commissioning laboratory, environmental authority and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: external collection network, unrelated pumping stations, unselected buildings or sludge dewatering
process, civil, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from design or peak flow coefficients
automatic odor control, tertiary polishing or standby power
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
